title: It’s What’s Inside (2024) a film that could’ve been better with a smaller budget

commenti.body: I disagree - I don’t really see “cheap” as an aesthetic. The filmmaker had a vision and got to execute on that. The editing is super extra and part of the film’s identity, and I think the over the top decor and sets, use of color (RGB having a thematic / storytelling purpose), and tight plotting really work for what they were going for.
